title: This Bitcoin Miner-Turned-Data Center Operator’s Stock is Jumping on a $9B Deal With Anthropic
excerpt: Riot Platforms shares are surging on a deal with a big name in AI.
content_html:
Aaron McDade

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 10:53 AM CDT 1 min read

Key Takeaways

  • Riot Platforms secured a $9.1 billion, 20-year deal to provide computing power to a major AI lab, reportedly Anthropic.

  • Shares of Riot Platforms have surged about 60% year-to-date, boosted by growing demand for AI compute.

Riot Platforms shares are surging on a deal with a big name in AI.

Shares of Riot Platforms (RIOT) were up about 4.5% in recent trading, a day after the company secured a $9.1 billion, 20-year deal to supply 191 megawatts of computing power to "one of the world's leading frontier AI labs." Bloomberg reported late last night that the lab is Anthropic, citing people familiar with the deal.

The compute will come from Riot's Rockdale, Texas facility, and be brought online in phases through June 2028. The Anthropic deal is Riot's second data center agreement, after the company also signed a deal to provide Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) with between 25 and 200 megawatts of "critical IT load capacity" back in January.

Riot, one of several cryptocurrency mining companies pivoting to cloud computing to capitalize on growing AI demand, topped analysts' estimates with $174.24 million in second-quarter revenue, more than $20 million of which came from its new data center business. Riot recorded a net loss of $237.17 million, nearly double the loss analysts had forecast.

Anthropic and Riot did not respond to requests for comment on the report in time for publication. With Tuesday's rally, Riot shares have gained roughly 60% since the start of the year.

content_html_zh:
亚伦·麦克达德

2026 年 8 月 11 日星期二上午 10:53 CDT 阅读时间 1 分钟

要点

  • Riot Platforms 获得了一项价值 91 亿美元、为期 20 年的协议，为一家大型人工智能实验室（据报道为 Anthropic）提供计算能力。
  • 由于人工智能计算需求不断增长，Riot Platforms 的股价今年迄今已飙升约 60%。

Riot Platforms 因与人工智能领域知名企业达成交易而股价飙升。

Riot Platforms (RIOT) 的股价在最近的交易中上涨了约 4.5%，一天前该公司获得了一项价值 91 亿美元、为期 20 年的协议，为“世界领先的前沿人工智能实验室之一”提供 191 兆瓦的计算能力。 彭博社昨晚深夜援引知情人士的话报道称，该实验室是 Anthropic 的。

该计算将来自 Riot 位于德克萨斯州罗克代尔的工厂，并在 2028 年 6 月之前分阶段上线。 Anthropic 协议是 Riot 的第二份数据中心协议，此前该公司还于 1 月份签署了一项为 Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) 提供 25 至 200 兆瓦“关键 IT 负载容量”的协议。

Riot 是几家转向云计算以利用不断增长的人工智能需求的加密货币挖矿公司之一，第二季度收入超过分析师预期，达到 1.7424 亿美元，其中超过 2000 万美元来自其新数据中心业务。 Riot 净亏损 2.3717 亿美元，几乎是分析师预测亏损的两倍。

Anthropic 和 Riot 没有及时回应对该报告发表评论的请求。 随着周二的上涨，Riot 股价自年初以来已上涨约 60%。
